title: Quadratic differentials and random walks on the dual graph of a pants decomposition
summary: Let X be an infinite Riemann surface with an upper-bounded geodesic pants decomposition. The vertices of the corresponding dual graph G are pairs of pants and edges are cuffs with conductances equal to their lengths. We prove that the geodesic flow on X is ergodic if and only if the random walk on G is recurrent. This yields explicit criteria for deciding, in terms of cuff-length growth, whether the geodesic flow is ergodic.
